nodes.label: Circle
nodes.description: Analytic circle collider. Cheap.

nodes.label: FromLayer
nodes.description: Build a collider from any shape layer (rect, ellipse, polygon, triangle).

nodes.label: Rect
nodes.description: Axis-aligned rectangle collider.

nodes.label: Color
nodes.description: Build a colour. Pick mode (rgb / hsl / hex) and the input pins adapt.

nodes.label: Gradient
nodes.description: Sample a gradient of color stops at t ∈ [0, 1].

nodes.label: Hex
nodes.description: Legacy — use the unified Color node instead.

nodes.label: HSL
nodes.description: Legacy — use the unified Color node instead.

nodes.label: Lerp
nodes.description: Linear interpolation in RGB between a and b.

nodes.label: Palette
nodes.description: Author a list of colours by clicking swatches.

nodes.label: RGB
nodes.description: Legacy — use the unified Color node instead.

nodes.label: SetAlpha
nodes.description: Replace the alpha channel (0..255) of a color.

nodes.label: SplitColor
nodes.description: Decompose a colour into channels. Pick mode (rgb or hsl); alpha is exposed in both.

nodes.label: SplitHSL
nodes.description: Legacy — use the unified SplitColor node instead.

nodes.label: SplitRGB
nodes.description: Legacy — use the unified SplitColor node instead.

nodes.label: ToBool
nodes.description: Convert any value to a boolean.

nodes.label: ToDegrees
nodes.description: Scale a unit value [0, 1] to degrees [0, 360].

nodes.label: ToInt
nodes.description: Round any value to the nearest integer.

nodes.label: ToNumber
nodes.description: Convert any value to a number.

nodes.label: ToRadians
nodes.description: Convert an angle from degrees to radians.

nodes.label: ToString
nodes.description: Convert any value to a string.

nodes.label: CSVInline
nodes.description: Parse inline CSV data into a number spread.

nodes.label: CSVFile
nodes.description: Load the numbers in a CSV file (a path relative to the patch, a URL, or a File node's url) into a number spread. Pick a column, or -1 for every cell.

nodes.label: Arc
nodes.description: Draw an arc segment from `start` to `stop` radians.

nodes.label: Ellipse
nodes.description: Draw an ellipse anchored at `pos`. `anchor` picks which point of the bounding box `pos` is — center (default) or a corner (tl/tr/bl/br).

nodes.label: Image
nodes.description: Draw an image at `pos` with size (w, h).

nodes.label: ImageRegion
nodes.description: Draw a sub-rectangle of an image onto a destination rect.

nodes.label: ImageTile
nodes.description: Tile an image `cols × rows` times across a rect.

nodes.label: Line
nodes.description: Draw a line from point `a` to point `b`.

nodes.label: Path
nodes.description: Stroke a path through a spread of vec2 points. Tension > 0 turns straight lines into Catmull–Rom curves. Wire `widths` to taper.

nodes.label: Point
nodes.description: Draw a single point at `pos`.

nodes.label: Polygon
nodes.description: Draw a polygon from a spread of vec2 points. Optionally wire a `widths` spread to taper the stroke into a filled offset polygon.

nodes.label: Quad
nodes.description: Draw a quadrilateral from four corner points.

nodes.label: Rect
nodes.description: Draw a rectangle anchored at `pos`. `anchor` picks which point of the box `pos` is — center (default) or a corner (tl/tr/bl/br).

nodes.label: Text
nodes.description: Draw a text string at `pos`.

nodes.label: Triangle
nodes.description: Draw a triangle from three corner points.

nodes.label: WalkerCluster
nodes.description: Spawn a cluster of random walkers that paint trails and circles.

nodes.label: Font
nodes.description: A font for `style/text-params`: an installed family, or a font file (.ttf, .otf, .ttc, .woff, .woff2) — a file wins. Lists the font’s variation axes (tag, min, default, max).

nodes.label: Glyphs
nodes.description: Text split into shaped glyphs, laid out like `draw/text`. `shape` draws them all; per glyph: a layer drawn at the origin (translate it to its position), its baseline position, advance, source characters and character index — for kinetic type in a ForEach.

nodes.label: Text on Path
nodes.description: Lay text along a path — a point spread, or a wired `path` layer (`draw/path`, polygon, line, ellipse). Each glyph turns to the tangent. `offset` slides the text along, `shift` lifts it off the path; `closed` wraps around a loop.

nodes.label: Text Outline
nodes.description: Points sampled along the glyph outlines (`outline`) or on a grid inside them (`fill`), every `spacing` units, laid out like `draw/text` — for particles from type, morphing, plotter-style lines. With each point’s contour and glyph index.

nodes.label: Attractor
nodes.description: Radial pull toward a point. Negative strength = repulsion. Falloff curve baked at compile.

nodes.label: Drag
nodes.description: Velocity-proportional damping, applied per-particle.

nodes.label: Gravity
nodes.description: Uniform vector force (acts like gravity).

nodes.label: Repulsor
nodes.description: Radial push away from a point.

nodes.label: Turbulence
nodes.description: Perlin-noise vector field. Each particle gets a force from the local gradient; time drifts the field.

nodes.label: Vortex
nodes.description: Rotational force around a centre, with optional radial pull. Counter-clockwise when axisStrength > 0.

nodes.label: Wind
nodes.description: Directional force with optional noise variation. Mass-dependent (heavier = less push).

nodes.label: Shader
nodes.description: Fragment shader (ShaderToy-style) with optional Buffer A–D passes. Wire a layer for post-FX, or leave it for generative. Edit in the side panel.

nodes.label: Adjust
nodes.description: Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, and hue.

nodes.label: Blend
nodes.description: Composite image B onto image A using the chosen blend mode.

nodes.label: Convolve
nodes.description: Apply a 3×3 convolution kernel (edge, sharpen, emboss).

nodes.label: Crop
nodes.description: Crop an image to the rectangle (sx, sy, sw, sh).

nodes.label: Dims
nodes.description: Read an image's pixel dimensions and aspect ratio.

nodes.label: Filter
nodes.description: Apply an image filter (blur, gray, threshold, posterize, …).

nodes.label: Rasterize
nodes.description: Rasterize a layer into an image at (w, h).

nodes.label: Pixelate
nodes.description: Pixelate an image into chunky blocks of `size` source pixels.

nodes.label: Resize
nodes.description: Resize an image to (w, h).

nodes.label: Sample
nodes.description: Read one pixel of an image as a color.

nodes.label: SampleSpread
nodes.description: Read a spread of points from an image as a spread of colors.

nodes.label: Slicer
nodes.description: Split an image into a cols × rows grid of sub-images.

nodes.label: Camera
nodes.description: Live webcam / connected-camera feed as an image. Flip `start` on to open the camera.

nodes.label: Keyboard
nodes.description: Read the last key pressed in the preview.

nodes.label: Landmarks
nodes.description: Hand / face / pose tracking (MediaPipe). Wire an image + flip `start`; outputs landmark points, depth, and per-detection grouping.

nodes.label: MidiCC
nodes.description: Read a single MIDI Control Change message.

nodes.label: MidiNote
nodes.description: Read the last MIDI note held (monophonic).

nodes.label: Mouse
nodes.description: Read mouse position and button state from the preview.

nodes.label: Bang
nodes.description: Momentary trigger — click to emit `true` for one tick, then `false`. Wire into a rising-edge input (e.g. a send/reset).

nodes.label: Button
nodes.description: Momentary boolean — `true` while pressed, `false` on release (vs Toggle, which latches).

nodes.label: ColorPicker
nodes.description: Pick a colour and its r/g/b channels.

nodes.label: Counter
nodes.description: Add `step` to a running count on each rising edge of `inc`; `reset` returns it to `start`.

nodes.label: Edge
nodes.description: Emit a one-tick bang when `in` rises past / falls below `threshold`, or whenever it changes. Turns a continuous signal into a trigger.

nodes.label: File
nodes.description: Pick a file from disk — outputs a URL and image handle.

nodes.label: Gate
nodes.description: Pass `value` through while `open` is true; when closed, hold the last value that passed. Flow control / sample-and-hold.

nodes.label: ImageURL
nodes.description: Load an image from a URL.

nodes.label: Metro
nodes.description: Emit a one-tick bang every `interval` seconds while `run` is on. Drives periodic actions (pairs with Counter).

nodes.label: SaveSVG
nodes.description: Export wired layers as an SVG file when `save` rises.

nodes.label: Select
nodes.description: Choose one of a list of options (comma-separated) — outputs the selected string.

nodes.label: Slider
nodes.description: Drag to set a number.

nodes.label: Stepper
nodes.description: An integer you nudge with +/− buttons (clamped to min/max, by step).

nodes.label: SVG
nodes.description: Load an SVG as vector layers. Pick a file, give a URL, or paste markup.

nodes.label: Toggle
nodes.description: Click to flip a boolean on or off.

nodes.label: XYPad
nodes.description: Drag a 2D point — outputs x, y in [0, 1].

nodes.label: And
nodes.description: True when both a and b are true.

nodes.label: Equal
nodes.description: True when a equals b.

nodes.label: Greater
nodes.description: True when a is greater than b.

nodes.label: GreaterEq
nodes.description: True when a is greater than or equal to b.

nodes.label: Less
nodes.description: True when a is less than b.

nodes.label: LessEq
nodes.description: True when a is less than or equal to b.

nodes.label: NotEqual
nodes.description: True when a does not equal b.

nodes.label: Not
nodes.description: Invert a boolean.

nodes.label: Or
nodes.description: True when either a or b is true.

nodes.label: Select
nodes.description: Pick a when cond is true, otherwise b.

nodes.label: Abs
nodes.description: Absolute value of x (component-wise for vec2 / color).

nodes.label: Acos
nodes.description: Arccosine in radians. Input clamped to [-1, 1].

nodes.label: Add
nodes.description: Sum all wired inputs (number, vec2, or color — adapts to what you plug in).

nodes.label: Asin
nodes.description: Arcsine in radians. Input clamped to [-1, 1].

nodes.label: Atan
nodes.description: Arctangent in radians.

nodes.label: Atan2
nodes.description: Angle of (x, y) in radians, full [-π, π] range.

nodes.label: Ceil
nodes.description: Round x up to the nearest integer.

nodes.label: Clamp
nodes.description: Constrain x to the range [min, max].

nodes.label: Cos
nodes.description: Cosine of x (radians).

nodes.label: Cumulative
nodes.description: Running sum of a number spread.

nodes.label: Delta
nodes.description: Pairwise differences of a number spread (length N − 1).

nodes.label: Dist
nodes.description: Distance between (x1, y1) and (x2, y2).

nodes.label: Div
nodes.description: Divide the first input by subsequent ones (component-wise). Division by zero yields 0.

nodes.label: Exp
nodes.description: Exponential — eˣ.

nodes.label: Floor
nodes.description: Round x down to the nearest integer.

nodes.label: Fract
nodes.description: Fractional part of x — always non-negative.

nodes.label: Histogram
nodes.description: Bin counts of a number spread between `min` and `max`.

nodes.label: Lerp
nodes.description: Linear interpolate between a and b at t ∈ [0, 1]. Adapts a/b to number, vec2, or color; t is always a number.

nodes.label: Log
nodes.description: Natural logarithm. log(x ≤ 0) = 0.

nodes.label: Mag
nodes.description: Distance from the origin to (x, y).

nodes.label: Map
nodes.description: Remap x from [inMin, inMax] to [outMin, outMax].

nodes.label: Max
nodes.description: Largest of all wired inputs (component-wise for vec2 / color).

nodes.label: MaxSpread
nodes.description: Maximum value of a number spread.

nodes.label: Mean
nodes.description: Arithmetic mean of a number spread.

nodes.label: Median
nodes.description: Median of a number spread.

nodes.label: Min
nodes.description: Smallest of all wired inputs (component-wise for vec2 / color).

nodes.label: MinSpread
nodes.description: Minimum value of a number spread.

nodes.label: Mod
nodes.description: Euclidean modulo — a mod b, always non-negative.

nodes.label: Mul
nodes.description: Multiply all wired inputs (number, vec2, or color — component-wise).

nodes.label: Neg
nodes.description: Negate x (component-wise for vec2 / color).

nodes.label: Norm
nodes.description: Map x from [start, stop] to [0, 1] (inverse of Lerp).

nodes.label: Pow
nodes.description: Raise a to the power b.

nodes.label: Round
nodes.description: Round x to the nearest integer.

nodes.label: Sign
nodes.description: Sign of x: -1, 0, or +1.

nodes.label: Sin
nodes.description: Sine of x (radians).

nodes.label: Smoothstep
nodes.description: Smooth Hermite 0→1 ramp as x moves across [edge0, edge1]; flat outside.

nodes.label: Sq
nodes.description: Square of x (x²).

nodes.label: Sqrt
nodes.description: Square root of x. Negatives yield 0.

nodes.label: StdDev
nodes.description: Population standard deviation of a number spread.

nodes.label: Step
nodes.description: Returns 0 when x < edge, else 1 — a hard threshold.

nodes.label: Sub
nodes.description: Subtract subsequent inputs from the first (number, vec2, or color).

nodes.label: Sum
nodes.description: Sum of a number spread.

nodes.label: Tan
nodes.description: Tangent of x (radians).

nodes.label: Wrap
nodes.description: Wrap x into the half-open range [min, max) (modulo that keeps wrapping seamless).

nodes.label: Comment
nodes.description: Annotate the patch with a free-floating note.

nodes.label: Probe
nodes.description: Inspect the data on a wire — a persistent, scrollable readout that also reroutes the wire. Drag a wire out and Alt-click empty space to drop one.

nodes.label: Subpatch
nodes.description: Group nodes behind a single boundary with custom ports.

nodes.label: DelayLine
nodes.description: Echo `value` (number, vec2, or color) as it was `delay` seconds ago (linearly interpolated). History clears on recompile.

nodes.label: Ease
nodes.description: Remap t ∈ [0,1] through an easing curve. Pick the curve from the dropdown.

nodes.label: LFO
nodes.description: Low-frequency oscillator: a value that cycles between `min` and `max`, `rate` times a second. Shapes: sine, triangle, saw, ramp-down, square (`width` = the high part of the cycle), random (a new value each cycle) and smooth-random. `offset` shifts the phase (0..1); a rising edge on `reset` restarts the cycle. With `bpm` above 0, `rate` counts cycles per beat (0.25 = once a bar in 4/4). With `count` > 1, `value` carries that many copies, each `spread / count` of a cycle behind the last (random shapes get one sequence per copy) — wire it into a ForEach to animate many things at once. `phase` is the 0..1 position in the cycle.

nodes.label: Smooth
nodes.description: Exponentially ease toward `value` (number, vec2, or color). Higher `rate` = snappier; frame-rate independent.

nodes.label: Spring
nodes.description: Spring-follow `value` (number, vec2, or color) with stiffness + damping — overshoots and settles.

nodes.label: Trigger
nodes.description: Emit a single-frame `true` pulse: on any change, a rising edge, or crossing `threshold` upward.

nodes.label: CurlNoise
nodes.description: Divergence-free flow field — the curl of a Perlin potential at `pos·scale`. Returns a vec2 you can use to advect particles in smooth swirls (no sources or sinks).

nodes.label: Perlin
nodes.description: Sample 2D Perlin noise in [0, 1].

nodes.label: Bounds
nodes.description: Wrap, kill, or bounce particles at the edges of a rectangular boundary.

nodes.label: Emitter
nodes.description: Particle source. Owns a fixed-capacity buffer; integrates world forces + local forces each tick.

nodes.label: FromLayer
nodes.description: Sample points from any shape — pipe into an Emitter to spawn particles from that shape.

nodes.label: Render
nodes.description: Render a ParticleBuffer as a Layer. Template controls the per-particle shape.

nodes.label: Trail
nodes.description: Render a polyline trail behind every alive particle. Ring-buffer length is fixed (CONSTANT).

nodes.label: World
nodes.description: Physics world: gravity, drag, time scale, global forces, global colliders. Wire into one or more Emitters.

nodes.label: GetCol
nodes.description: Read one column of pixels (clamped to image bounds) as a spread of colors.

nodes.label: GetPixels
nodes.description: Read every pixel of an image as a row-major spread of colors.

nodes.label: GetRow
nodes.description: Read one row of pixels (clamped to image bounds) as a spread of colors.

nodes.label: SetCol
nodes.description: Write a spread of colors as one column of the image.

nodes.label: SetPixels
nodes.description: Write a spread of colors into a copy of the source image.

nodes.label: SetRow
nodes.description: Write a spread of colors as one row of the image.

nodes.label: PixelSort
nodes.description: Sort runs of pixels along rows or cols, masked by a value range.

nodes.label: Gaussian
nodes.description: Sample a Gaussian random number with given mean and stddev.

nodes.label: Uniform
nodes.description: Sample a uniform random number in [min, max).

nodes.label: Wanderer2D
nodes.description: Drift a 2D point smoothly using Perlin noise.

nodes.label: Read
nodes.description: Per-iteration accumulator read — paired with Write by slot.

nodes.label: Read
nodes.description: Per-iteration accumulator read — paired with Write by slot.

nodes.label: Read
nodes.description: Per-iteration accumulator read — paired with Write by slot.

nodes.label: Write
nodes.description: Per-iteration accumulator write — final emits after the loop.

nodes.label: Write
nodes.description: Per-iteration accumulator write — final emits after the loop.

nodes.label: Write
nodes.description: Per-iteration accumulator write — final emits after the loop.

nodes.label: Cache
nodes.description: Cache inner-scope outputs; re-run only when inputs change.

nodes.label: ForEach
nodes.description: Iterate inner nodes once per element of the input spread. Built-in index/count/fraction pins; delay staggers each iteration's time source.

nodes.label: If
nodes.description: Run inner nodes only when `condition` is true.

nodes.label: LoopVar
nodes.description: Per-iteration loop variable (index / count / fraction).

nodes.label: SplicerIn:any
nodes.description: Receive a Spread<any> from outside; deliver one slot per iteration.

nodes.label: SplicerIn:boolean
nodes.description: Receive a Spread<boolean> from outside; deliver one slot per iteration.

nodes.label: SplicerIn:color
nodes.description: Receive a Spread<color> from outside; deliver one slot per iteration.

nodes.label: SplicerIn:image
nodes.description: Receive a Spread<image> from outside; deliver one slot per iteration.

nodes.label: SplicerIn:layer
nodes.description: Receive a Spread<layer> from outside; deliver one slot per iteration.

nodes.label: SplicerIn:mat3
nodes.description: Receive a Spread<mat3> from outside; deliver one slot per iteration.

nodes.label: SplicerIn:number
nodes.description: Receive a Spread<number> from outside; deliver one slot per iteration.

nodes.label: SplicerIn:string
nodes.description: Receive a Spread<string> from outside; deliver one slot per iteration.

nodes.label: SplicerIn:style
nodes.description: Receive a Spread<style> from outside; deliver one slot per iteration.

nodes.label: SplicerIn:vec2
nodes.description: Receive a Spread<vec2> from outside; deliver one slot per iteration.

nodes.description: Collect one value per iteration into an outer Spread<any>.

nodes.description: Collect one value per iteration into an outer Spread<boolean>.

nodes.description: Collect one value per iteration into an outer Spread<color>.

nodes.description: Collect one value per iteration into an outer Spread<image>.

nodes.description: Collect one value per iteration into an outer Spread<layer>.

nodes.label: SplicerOut:mat3
nodes.description: Collect one value per iteration into an outer Spread<mat3>.

nodes.label: SplicerOut:number
nodes.description: Collect one value per iteration into an outer Spread<number>.

nodes.label: SplicerOut:string
nodes.description: Collect one value per iteration into an outer Spread<string>.

nodes.label: SplicerOut:style
nodes.description: Collect one value per iteration into an outer Spread<style>.

nodes.label: SplicerOut:vec2
nodes.description: Collect one value per iteration into an outer Spread<vec2>.

nodes.label: Renderer
nodes.description: Render wired layers to the preview canvas.

nodes.label: Amplitude
nodes.description: Measure the RMS level of an audio signal.

nodes.label: AudioIn
nodes.description: Read audio from the microphone.

nodes.label: Compressor
nodes.description: Compress audio dynamics with threshold, ratio, attack, and release.

nodes.label: Delay
nodes.description: Echo an audio signal with feedback and lowpass damping.

nodes.label: Distortion
nodes.description: Waveshaper distortion driven by `amount`.

nodes.label: Envelope
nodes.description: Shape an audio signal with an ADSR envelope.

nodes.label: FFT
nodes.description: Analyse audio into frequency-bin and waveform spreads.

nodes.label: Filter
nodes.description: Biquad filter — lowpass, highpass, or bandpass.

nodes.label: FreqToMidi
nodes.description: Convert a frequency in Hz to a MIDI note number.

nodes.label: Gain
nodes.description: Multiply an audio signal by `level`.

nodes.label: MidiToFreq
nodes.description: Convert a MIDI note number to frequency in Hz.

nodes.label: MonoSynth
nodes.description: Play a single MIDI-note voice with an ADSR envelope.

nodes.label: Noise
nodes.description: Generate white, pink, or brown noise.

nodes.label: Oscillator
nodes.description: Generate a sine, triangle, saw, or square waveform.

nodes.label: Output
nodes.description: Send an audio chain to the speakers.

nodes.label: PeakDetect
nodes.description: Detect amplitude peaks within a frequency band.

nodes.label: Pulse
nodes.description: Generate a square wave with adjustable pulse width.

nodes.label: Reverb
nodes.description: Add convolution reverb to an audio signal.

nodes.label: SoundFile
nodes.description: Load and play an audio file from URL.

nodes.label: AppendSpread
nodes.description: Append a single value to the end of a spread.

nodes.label: AtSpread
nodes.description: Pick one element from a spread by index.

nodes.label: AtGroupSpread
nodes.description: Pick the Nth group as a sub-spread, given flat + groupSize.

nodes.label: CAGridSeedSpread
nodes.description: Seed a 2D boolean grid with one live cell in the bottom row.

nodes.label: CASeedSpread
nodes.description: Seed a 1D CA row with one live cell at `index`.

nodes.label: ConsSpread
nodes.description: Prepend a single value to a spread.

nodes.label: CountSpread
nodes.description: Length of a spread.

nodes.label: CountWhereSpread
nodes.description: Count true entries in a boolean spread.

nodes.label: CrossProductSpread
nodes.description: Cartesian product of two spreads as two parallel spreads.

nodes.label: CycleSpread
nodes.description: Repeat a spread cyclically until the output reaches `count` elements.

nodes.label: ElementaryCASpread
nodes.description: Advance a 1D elementary cellular automaton by one tick.

nodes.label: FibonacciSpread
nodes.description: Generate a sunflower spiral using the golden angle.

nodes.label: GeometricSpread
nodes.description: Geometric progression: start, start·ratio, start·ratio², …

nodes.label: GoLSeedSpread
nodes.description: Seed a Game-of-Life grid with random live cells.

nodes.label: GoLStepSpread
nodes.description: Advance Conway's Game of Life by one tick.

nodes.label: GridSpread
nodes.description: Generate a `cols × rows` grid of points centred on `center`.

nodes.label: IndexOfSpread
nodes.description: First index of a value in the spread, or -1.

nodes.label: IndicesByValueSpread
nodes.description: All indices where the spread matches `value`.

nodes.label: InjectSpread
nodes.description: Inject elements of `marks` at N evenly-spaced positions in `spread`.

nodes.label: InsertSliceSpread
nodes.description: Insert a spread at an index without overwriting.

nodes.label: InterleaveSpread
nodes.description: Interleave two spreads element-by-element.

nodes.label: LastRowSpread
nodes.description: Slice the bottom row from a 2D boolean grid.

nodes.label: LinearSpread
nodes.description: Generate a spread evenly stepping from `from` to `to`.

nodes.label: Merge
nodes.description: Combine multiple wires into one spread (each numbered slot takes one wire). Use it to feed several sources into a single input pin.

nodes.label: Neighbor
nodes.description: Read a neighbouring element by relative `offset` (e.g. -1 / +1). Inside a ForEach: broadcast the iterated spread into `spread` and wire the region's `index` pin. `edges` sets out-of-range behaviour: clamp (repeat ends), wrap (toroidal), or zero (empty).

nodes.label: NoiseSpread
nodes.description: 1-D Perlin noise sampled at regular intervals, in [0, 1].

nodes.label: PairwiseSpread
nodes.description: Adjacent pairs: outputs (s[0..n-1]) and (s[1..n]).

nodes.label: PartitionSpread
nodes.description: Chunk a spread into fixed-size groups. Outputs flat + groupSize.

nodes.label: PermuteSpread
nodes.description: Reorder elements by an index spread.

nodes.label: PickSpread
nodes.description: Index into `source` using each entry of `indices`. Output length = indices length; output[i] = source[indices[i] mod source.length]. Out-of-range indices wrap.

nodes.label: RandomizeSpread
nodes.description: Shuffle the input spread into a random order. Output length matches input; output type echoes input.

nodes.label: RangeSpread
nodes.description: Generate the integers 0, 1, …, count − 1.

nodes.label: RemoveSliceSpread
nodes.description: Delete `count` elements starting at `index`.

nodes.label: RepeatSpread
nodes.description: Repeat the input N times into a spread. A scalar becomes N copies; a spread of length K tiles to length N×K.

nodes.label: ResampleSpread
nodes.description: Resample a spread to a new length by linear interpolation.

nodes.label: ReverseSpread
nodes.description: Reverse the order of elements.

nodes.label: RingSpread
nodes.description: Lay `count` points evenly around a circle. `positions` are ready to place; `angles` (radians) drive orientation, spirals, or hue.

nodes.label: RotateSpread
nodes.description: Cyclic shift by N positions (negative shifts left).

nodes.label: ScrollUpSpread
nodes.description: Scroll a 2D boolean grid up one row and append newRow at the bottom.

nodes.label: SetSliceSpread
nodes.description: Replace element(s) at an index with another spread.

nodes.label: ShuffleSpread
nodes.description: Shuffle deterministically by seed.

nodes.label: SiftSpread
nodes.description: Keep elements where the parallel boolean spread is true.

nodes.label: SineSpread
nodes.description: Generate `count` samples of a sine wave.

nodes.label: SkipSpread
nodes.description: Drop the first N elements.

nodes.label: SliceSpread
nodes.description: Slice elements from start to end (end ≤ 0 counts from the end).

nodes.label: SortSpread
nodes.description: Sort numerically, ascending by default.

nodes.label: SortByKeySpread
nodes.description: Sort a spread by a parallel number spread.

nodes.label: SpiralSpread
nodes.description: Generate points along an Archimedean spiral.

nodes.label: StackSpread
nodes.description: Concatenate two spreads end-to-end.

nodes.label: SwapSpread
nodes.description: Swap two elements by index.

nodes.label: TakeSpread
nodes.description: Keep the first N elements.

nodes.label: Ungroup
nodes.description: Split a spread-of-spreads into one output pin per sub-spread (out 1…N). `count` sets the pins; missing groups emit empty spreads.

nodes.label: UninterleaveSpread
nodes.description: Split a spread into even- and odd-indexed elements.

nodes.label: UniqueSpread
nodes.description: Remove duplicates, preserving first occurrence.

nodes.label: WalkStepSpread
nodes.description: Advance a vec2 trail by one random-walk step.

nodes.label: WindowsSpread
nodes.description: Sliding windows of size N (stride 1). Outputs flat + windowSize.

nodes.label: Read
nodes.description: Emit the value last written under `slot`, or `init` on frame 0.

nodes.label: Read*
nodes.description: Emit the spread last written under `slot`, or `init` on frame 0.

nodes.label: StateSpread
nodes.description: Legacy: use Read* / Write* instead for left-to-right spread feedback.

nodes.label: State
nodes.description: Hold a single value across frames — emit last tick's `next` as `current`.

nodes.label: Write
nodes.description: Stash a value at end-of-tick; the matching Read emits it next tick.

nodes.label: Write*
nodes.description: Stash a spread at end-of-tick; the matching Read* emits it next tick.

nodes.label: Concat
nodes.description: Concatenate any number of strings into one. Wire multiple strings into `parts` (the pin gathers them); `separator` goes between each.

nodes.label: Length
nodes.description: Number of characters in the input string.

nodes.label: Split
nodes.description: Split a string into a Spread<string>. With `by=""` (default) you get one item per character; with `by=" "` one item per word.

nodes.label: WordIndices
nodes.description: For each character of `text`, output the word index that character belongs to. Words are separated by `by` (default " "). Separators themselves take the index of the word that just ended, so per-char colouring stays continuous.

nodes.label: Blur
nodes.description: Gaussian-blur downstream shapes by N pixels (fill, stroke, and text alike). 0 = sharp.

nodes.label: EllipseMode
nodes.description: Set how Ellipse interprets (x, y, w, h).

nodes.label: Fill
nodes.description: Set the fill colour for downstream shapes. Wire a Color node into `color`.

nodes.label: NoFill
nodes.description: Disable the fill on downstream shapes.

nodes.label: NoStroke
nodes.description: Disable the stroke on downstream shapes.

nodes.label: RectMode
nodes.description: Set how Rect interprets (x, y, w, h).

nodes.label: Stroke
nodes.description: Set the stroke colour, width, and alignment (center / inside / outside the outline). Alignment applies to closed shapes.

nodes.label: StrokeCap
nodes.description: Set the line end-cap shape.

nodes.label: StrokeJoin
nodes.description: Set how stroke corners are joined.

nodes.label: StrokeWeight
nodes.description: Set the stroke thickness in pixels.

nodes.label: TextParams
nodes.description: Override typographic style for downstream text — font family, weight, italic, alignment, kerning, line spacing.

nodes.label: FontVariations
nodes.description: Variable-font axes for downstream text, animatable per frame: weight (wght), width (wdth), slant (slnt), optical size (opsz), plus any axis by tag. 0 leaves an axis at the font’s default; chain nodes for more custom axes.

nodes.label: Delta
nodes.description: Seconds elapsed since the previous frame (dt) — for frame-rate-independent motion.

nodes.label: Frame
nodes.description: Output the integer frame counter.

nodes.label: Time
nodes.description: Output seconds elapsed since the patch started.

nodes.label: ApplyMatrix
nodes.description: Apply an arbitrary 2D affine transform to a layer.

nodes.label: Blend
nodes.description: Composite a layer using the chosen blend mode.

nodes.label: Cache
nodes.description: Rasterise a layer into a cached bitmap and blit it.

nodes.label: Group
nodes.description: Combine multiple layer wires into one layer.

nodes.label: Rotate
nodes.description: Rotate a layer by `angle` radians around the origin.

nodes.label: Scale
nodes.description: Scale a layer by (sx, sy).

nodes.label: ShearX
nodes.description: Shear a layer along the X axis by `angle` radians.

nodes.label: ShearY
nodes.description: Shear a layer along the Y axis by `angle` radians.

nodes.label: Translate
nodes.description: Translate a layer by the vector `by`.

nodes.label: Number
nodes.description: Hold a constant number.

nodes.label: String
nodes.description: Hold a constant string.

nodes.label: Add
nodes.description: Add two vec2s component-wise.

nodes.label: AngleBetween
nodes.description: Signed angle from a to b, in radians.

nodes.label: Dist
nodes.description: Distance between two points.

nodes.label: Dot
nodes.description: Dot product of a and b.

nodes.label: FromAngle
nodes.description: Polar → cartesian: unit vector at `angle` radians, scaled by `mag` (radius).

nodes.label: Heading
nodes.description: Angle of the vector in radians.

nodes.label: Lerp
nodes.description: Linear interpolate between a and b at t ∈ [0, 1] (component-wise).

nodes.label: Limit
nodes.description: Clamp the magnitude to at most `max`.

nodes.label: Mag
nodes.description: Length of the vector.

nodes.label: Vec2
nodes.description: Build a vec2 from (x, y).

nodes.label: Mul
nodes.description: Component-wise multiply.

nodes.label: Normalize
nodes.description: Unit vector in the same direction. Zero vectors stay zero.

nodes.label: Project
nodes.description: Vector projection of `a` onto `b`.

nodes.label: Reflect
nodes.description: Reflect `v` across the surface with `normal` (normal is normalised internally).

nodes.label: Rotate
nodes.description: Rotate the vector by `angle` radians around the origin.

nodes.label: Scale
nodes.description: Multiply a vec2 by a scalar.

nodes.label: SetMag
nodes.description: Rescale the vector to the given magnitude.

nodes.label: Split
nodes.description: Decompose a vec2 into x and y.

nodes.label: Sub
nodes.description: Subtract b from a component-wise.

nodes.label: ToPolar
nodes.description: Cartesian → polar: decompose a vec2 into `angle` (radians) and `radius`.

nodes.label: VideoFile
nodes.description: Play a video file (MP4 / MOV) as an image. Pick a file on the node; `scrub` (0..1) overrides playback while wired.

nodes.label: VideoFrameAt
nodes.description: One frame of a video file at `time` seconds: random access without playback.
